description: Read-only. Search Sedis's catalog of listed companies by name fragment or country code and return each company's `companyId` and name. This is the FIRST step of the Bolagsanalys flow: take a `companyId` from here and pass it to `bolagsanalys_get_data` to fetch its quarterly figures. Example: nameContains 'Volvo', countryCode 'SE'. Reference data shared across all tenants; this tool never writes or ingests.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: bolagsanalys_list_companies

companyId.description: Stable company id; pass to bolagsanalys_get_data.

isInactive.description: True if the company is inactive.

nextReportDate.description: ISO date of the next expected report, if known.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: List listed companies (Bolagsanalys)
